kraken-bern-combined-v1 on bern-val (practice lines)

Pick a line. Reference characters sit on the frames the forced CTC alignment gives them (8 px of the line per frame). Probes: per layer, ■ the layer's linear probes have the character (identity and emission), □ identity only, · neither. α overlay: one block of the model at parent (kraken-bern-hertwig-v2) + α·(child − parent), the rest unchanged; the character's fate there. Colours: black/white emitted, purple replaced, vermillion deleted. Hover a character for its column.
